comments.author: @djscar24
comments.text: The seed vault in Norway seems like a bad idea all the way around. It's located in one of the most inaccessible regions in the World. If we did experience a global tragedy who would even be able to reach it, or access it??? The only more inaccessible place would have been Antarctica. The only one's with the codes are the one's that are there running it. No one else has Access. The US, and a few other countries, pays millions to operate it, yet we are the one's located the farthest from the facility, and likely wouldn't be able to reach it if we needed it. Bad investment for the US. We need to fund our own vault. Once again we are funding something for Europe that in no way benefits the US. If the planet is nearly destroyed, we're screwed. The hell with the saving of humanity if no American will benefit from it. If Americans are all dead, who's going to save Europe next time???
